narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of northeast North Carolina.
ev: Flash flooding was reported on Menola Saint Johns Road.
Road was flooded by Currituck county High School. All four lanes were covered.
Flash flooding was reported on Trotman Road between Sandy Hook Road and Highway 343.
Flash flooding was reported on McArthur Drive.
There were numerous reports of extensive flooding in the downtown area of Elizabeth City with multiple vehicles underwater. Road Street, Elizabeth Street and Riverside Avenue were impassable.
High water was reported on portions of Trotman Road and Route 343.
Flooding on side roads was reported throughout the county.
